description: Talk a thread through by voice, then say "send that" to message the agent. Phreak answers from the chat, catches up each time the agent finishes a turn, and offers anything that needs code, files or commands to the agent. Each message it sends shows as a card with bb's delivery status and the exact text. Needs bb 0.50 or later, the ChatGPT Realtime Connection plugin (codex-realtime) with phreak allowed, and the Codex CLI signed in with ChatGPT on a plan that includes Codex. Voice counts against that plan, OpenAI receives your mic audio and the thread's text, and this undocumented use of the sign-in may stop working at any time.
